title: Shift Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Shift module.

change_class.description: Classification of the spec change. Conservative — when in doubt upgrade to higher class.

reverse_drift_detected.description: True if implementation diverges from spec in this session.

reverse_drift_details.description: Description of drift found. Null if reverse_drift_detected is false.

downstream_consumers_affected.description: Count of modules affected by this change.

affected_consumer_ids.description: Module IDs from framework.yaml affected by this change.

semantic_diff_path.description: Path to semantic diff output. e.g. .wabblespec/shift/diff-<timestamp>.md

loop_back_required.description: True when change_class is BREAKING and downstream_consumers_affected > 0. Blocks archive until consumers are notified.
